title: Claude Code MCP server configuration (.mcp.json)
description: MCP server configuration for a Claude Code plugin: the contents of .mcp.json at the plugin root, either a map of server name to server config wrapped in "mcpServers", or that map with the wrapper omitted. The same map is accepted inline as plugin.json's mcpServers (plugin-manifest-schema defines that map once, and this file points to it).
$comment: Entry point for .mcp.json: the server map, wrapped in mcpServers or bare (a plugin's .mcp.json may omit the wrapper). The map is defined once in plugin-manifest-schema.
